low-cost.title: Low-cost chat
low-cost.note: Cheapest full-featured tier in the catalog as of data_as_of: $0.03/$0.13 per 1M tokens with a 1M context window. Backup adds a second vendor; fallback stays cheap ($0.10/$0.40) and long-context.

code.title: Code generation
code.note: Primary is a coding-tuned model; backup and fallback are code-capable general models at roughly one-quarter of the primary's output price, so a fallback still ships working code at low cost.

long-context.title: Long context
long-context.note: All three expose ~1M token windows. Kimi K3 leads on input price ($0.19/1M) for corpus-style work; the fallbacks keep the chain alive when the primary is rate-limited or delisted.

low-latency.title: Low-latency interaction
low-latency.note: Flash/mini/haiku tiers are the vendors' latency-optimized lines. Keep max_tokens low; all three support 400k+ context so interactive sessions rarely hit a hard ceiling.

vision.title: Image input (vision)
vision.note: All three declare image input modality in the catalog. Primary is a dedicated VL line at the lowest per-1M price; backup and fallback are general multimodals that also accept files.

multi-turn.title: Multi-turn conversation
multi-turn.note: Long, cheap context for conversation history: primary runs 1M tokens at $0.26/$0.78 per 1M. Fallbacks diversify vendors so a single provider outage does not end the session.
